svg.title: Previous greater element with a monotonic stack on [5, 3, 1, 3, 4, 2]
svg.desc: Stack of index: value after each i. i=0 pushes 0, answer -1. i=1 answer 0. i=2 answer 1. i=3 pops 2 and 1, answer 0, stack [0, 3]. i=4 pops 3, answer 0, stack [0, 4]. i=5 answer 4, stack [0, 4, 5]. Answer [-1, 0, 1, 0, 0, 4], 6 pushes, 3 pops.
